This is Pokémon’s best set this year. We love all the cards in this set especially all the 30th Pikachus. The Japanese MEGA Expansion Pack 30th CELEBRATION is a premium set of 103 main cards that offers good value for collectors, ensuring an all-holo layout with a specialized artist-driven Pikachu and a basic foil energy inside every single six-card pack. These packs contains lots of hits, making the pull rates for the elusive cards or the legendary gold-bordered retro reprints highly rewarding. It’s just a fun set and hope to be able to get more.
